summary: Route pull-request verification through a deterministic change classifier while keeping every selected lane fail closed in the stable CI aggregate.
security: The stable CI aggregate rejects a selected job that is skipped, missing, cancelled, timed out, action-required, or failed.
Unknown paths select the broad verification route instead of silently using a reduced test set.
documentation: Workflow summaries explain the detected change classes and the verification lanes selected for each pull request.
knownLimitations: Path classification cannot infer runtime effects outside the repository; unrecognized repository paths therefore use the broad verification route.
rollback: Revert the classifier and reusable detection workflow together to restore the previous broad run-tests selection.
validation: Test deterministic path classification, required-check aggregation, workflow contracts, and release-note-only fast-path behavior.
Verify TypeORM, authorization, Operaton, plugin, image, security, and documentation changes select their owning lanes.
Verify broad workspace dependency files do not select the independent five-database, identity-protocol, or deployment-evidence workflows unless an owning change surface is present.
Require documentation-only changes to run the publication-boundary guard without installing application dependencies.
